name: ReflectionAccessError reports denial context without leaking inaccessible data

applicability.reason: Supported. C108 requires a denial to report caller package, operation, target scope and denial origin without leaking inaccessible data. The denial itself was already reachable through the host `iris.grants` boundary C009 places the policy behind; what was absent is the context, which is now recorded at the point of refusal and read back through ExceptionContext. It reports the target's SCOPE rather than any member data, so a denial cannot leak what it just refused to expose, and the origin is the Host grant boundary because C009 places trusted reflection policy exclusively there. C066 forbids fabricating one, so a context raised by anything other than a reflection denial answers nil.
